rationale: Create Stagecoach Renewables, LLC as the canonical U.S. renewable-energy land-and-development-royalties platform. Apollo's official materials confirm that Apollo-managed funds invested in the platform, and Apollo Infrastructure Company's March 2025 Form 10-K describes an Apollo Infrastructure partner as currently sitting on its board while expressly distinguishing former board roles. Current legal and professional sources corroborate the Stagecoach Renewables, Stagecoach Royalty and Stagecoach Royalty Holdings identities and the platform's U.S. wind-and-solar royalty model. Retain the accepted census's 2019 investment year with year-only precision, leave the exact stake and specific fund undisclosed, and do not double-count the platform's holding entity, property interests, royalties or underlying projects. No Apollo exit or signed pending ownership change was identified through August 12, 2026.

afterImage.description: Stagecoach Renewables, LLC, also known as Stagecoach Royalty, is an Apollo-backed U.S. renewable-energy land-and-development-royalties platform. The business acquires property interests and long-term royalty interests tied to wind and solar development rights in Texas, Colorado and other major U.S. renewable-energy markets. Apollo-managed infrastructure funds invested in 2019. The exact ownership percentage, specific fund, legal investment vehicle, founding year and current headquarters are not publicly disclosed. Apollo Infrastructure materials continued to identify an Apollo partner on the Stagecoach Renewables board in March 2025, and no Apollo exit or signed pending ownership change was identified through August 12, 2026.
